newsitem.title: TURKEY: Eight die in Turkey prison disturbance.
newsitem.headline: Eight die in Turkey prison disturbance.

text.p: Eight people died in a riot at a Turkish prison that was quelled by baton-wielding gendarmerie police on Wednesday.
"The information I have received shows that there are eight dead and 11 injured," an Istanbul health board official told Reuters.
Inmates took a warden hostage and set fire to their cells at Istanbul's Metris prison on Tuesday night, prompting intervention by gendarmerie police, Anatolian news agency said.
Anatolian said the gendarmes had gained control over much of the prison after beginning an operation at 7.30 a.m. (0430 GMT).
Turkish television showed pictures of gendarmes beating inmates with batons and rifle butts at the prison.
Five of the dead and five injured were taken to Sagmalcilar hospital, a hospital official said.
Anatolian said the cause of the riot was the stabbing to death of an inmate on Monday night. The rioters were jailed for criminal offenses and had no political demands, the agency said.
"I listened to their requests. They said they wanted better treatment and conditions," Anatolian quoted Istanbul governor Ridvan Yenisen as saying after visiting the prison.
The jail holds 1,200 people despite being built for only 700 inmates.
